verdict.rationale: Square publishes a first-party 'Square Model Context Protocol Server' docs page, and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at developer.squareup.com/docs/mcp. That directly covers connecting an agent via an official MCP server, but the evidence is only a page title and a probe hit, with no detail. Missing for 10: details on the exposed tools/APIs, authentication and setup flow, hosted vs local transport, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
